outcome: Admission to Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
Admission to Neonatal Intermediate Care Unit (NIMCU)
cohort: This study analyzed newborns from the Unified Health System (SUS) in Sao Paulo in 2012.
finding: Inadequate prenatal care, prematurity, and low birth weight were identified as risk factors for both neonatal hospitalization and mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of neonatal hospitalization (RR = 1.1, 95% CI 1.1 - 1.2).
gest_age: Prematurity categorized as <= 32 weeks and 32 to 36 weeks
birth_weight: Low birth weight categorized as < 1,500 g and 1,500 to 2,499 g
